Checking whether CreateMemoComment routes through CreateMemo, and whether any migration calls memopayload RunOnce.

Also examining frontend usage of derived metadata. The relevant fields appear to be MemoPayload.Property flags and MemoPayload.Tags extracted from #tags. Snippet is computed on-the-fly in convertMemoFromStore rather than stored in the payload.

The stored payload system is the primary source of derived metadata. The runtime snippet is used for previews. I will focus on the stored payload for the answer.
Checking the Memo API property definition in proto and the CreateMemoComment path.

The memo metadata derivation logic is now clear.

Core extraction lives in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll`, `ExtractProperties`) and parses markdown via goldmark/GFM. `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`RebuildMemoPayload`) orchestrates the call and persists results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. A runtime snippet helper in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` also invokes `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet` from the same package.

`CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` trigger `RebuildMemoPayload` before persisting. `UpdateMemo` only does so when the update mask includes `"content"`. `CreateMemoComment` triggers it indirectly through `CreateMemo`. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` performs a batch rebuild for maintenance or migration. The snippet is computed on read in `memo_service_converter.go`.

Tags come from `#tag` tokens parsed by `internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`, excluding those inside links or images. `property.has_link` is true when markdown link nodes appear. `property.has_code` is true for code blocks, fenced code blocks, and inline code spans. `property.has_task_list` is true for GFM task checkboxes. `property.has_incomplete_tasks` is true for unchecked task checkboxes. `property.title` is the plain text of the first block-level H1 heading. The snippet is a plain-text summary up to 64 characters, computed at response time and not stored in the payload. Location is not derived from content; the user sets it.

h14.

**Computation site:** Content-derived metadata is parsed in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractAll` / `ExtractProperties` walk the goldmark/GFM AST; tags use the custom parser in `internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`). It is assembled and written to the stored `MemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` via `RebuildMemoPayload`, which sets `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (schema in `proto/store/memo.proto`). List/preview snippets are computed separately at API response time in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (`getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`), e.g. from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`.

**Triggers:** `RebuildMemoPayload` runs on `CreateMemo` (always, before persist) in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`; on `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes `"content"` in the same file; and indirectly on `CreateMemoComment`, which calls `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`. There is also a batch backfill path, `Runner.RunOnce` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, that rebuilds payloads for all memos. Snippets are recomputed on every memo read/conversion, not stored in the payload.

**Extracted properties:** From content into persisted payload — `tags` (`#tag` tokens, deduplicated, excluding tags inside links/images); `property.has_link` (link nodes); `property.has_code` (code block / fenced block / inline code); `property.has_task_list` (GFM task checkboxes); `property.has_incomplete_tasks` (unchecked task boxes); `property.title` (plain text of the first block-level H1, if any). At response time (not user-set, not in payload): `snippet` — plain-text summary truncated to 64 characters. `location` in `MemoPayload` is user-provided, not content-derived.
